subject: prd/argus
statement: When the front door receives an idea, Argus shall open a problem ledger recording the idea verbatim, the principal identity, the authority-contract version, and — when provided — the per-problem grant override and any pre-rulings, each binding as a ruling-in-advance.
rationale: the root artifact every ruling traces to; optional overrides and pre-rulings are D-4's carried sub-clauses (brainstorm:autonomous-developer#D-4, #D-9)
fit_criterion: 100% of accepted problems have a ledger with all required fields; every provided pre-ruling is cited by the later rulings that rely on it
